MedDRA PT: Myocarditis
Product: mRNA-1273 (Spikevax)
Lot Number: LOT-25493

1. Patient Information
Age: 68 years
Sex: Male
Weight: 63 kg
Medical History: None reported
2. Drug Information
Drug Name: mRNA-1273 (Spikevax)
Indication: Prevention of COVID-19
Dose: 100 mcg / 0.5 mL
Route: Intramuscular
Dose Number: Dose 2
Date of Administration: 20 June 2025
3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 71-year-old male received Dose 2 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 14 July 2025. Approximately 12 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Myocarditis. The patient sought medical attention and was managed outpatient. The outcome was recovered without sequelae. The reporter considers the event related to mRNA-1273 vaccination.
4. Causality Assessment
Reporter Causality: Related

WHO-UMC Causality: Probable
